name: Ezogabine
aliases: Retigabine, retigabine, RTG, EZG, AWD-21360, D-23129, Potiga®, Trobalt®
summary: Retigabine (INN) or ezogabine (USAN) is an anticonvulsant used as an adjunctive treatment for partial epilepsies in treatment-experienced adult patients. The drug was developed by Valeant Pharmaceuticals and GlaxoSmithKline.

pharmacology.text: Retigabine acts as a neuronal KCNQ/Kv7 potassium channel opener, a mechanism of action markedly different from that of any current anticonvulsants. This mechanism of action is similar to that of the chemically similar flupirtine, which is used mainly for its analgesic properties.

body.says: Liver glucuronidation and acetylation. CYP not involved

uses.text: Retigabine (INN) or ezogabine (USAN) is an anticonvulsant used as an adjunctive treatment for partial epilepsies in treatment-experienced adult patients. The drug was developed by Valeant Pharmaceuticals and GlaxoSmithKline.

sideEffects.text: The adverse effects found in the Phase II trial mainly affected the central nervous system, and appeared to be dose-related. The most common adverse effects were drowsiness, dizziness, tinnitus and vertigo, confusion, and slurred speech. Less common side effects included tremor, memory loss, gait disturbances, and double vision.

summaryZh: 瑞替加濱或依佐加濱是一種由Valeant Pharmaceuticals和GlaxoSmithKline開發的抗驚厥藥，並於2011年6月10日獲得美國食品和藥物管理局批准，商品名為Potiga ，用作有治療經驗的成年患者部分性癲癇的輔助治療。 瑞替加濱為鉀通道開放劑，即通過激活大腦中特定的電壓鉀通道家族。
summaryZhHans: 瑞替加滨或依佐加滨是一种由Valeant Pharmaceuticals和GlaxoSmithKline开发的抗惊厥药，并于2011年6月10日获得美国食品和药物管理局批准，商品名为Potiga ，用作有治疗经验的成年患者部分性癫痫的辅助治疗。 瑞替加滨为钾通道开放剂，即通过激活大脑中特定的电压钾通道家族。
